#Import libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
```


#Import files
```{r}
labels_lidar <- read.csv("lidar_labels/lidar_labels_NYH2_NYH3_2020-24.csv")
labels_msi <- read.csv("msi_labels/msi_labels_NYH2_NYH3_2020-24.csv")

#Get G2F information
labels2020 = read_csv("https://de.cyverse.org/anon-files/iplant/home/shared/commons_repo/curated/GenomesToFields_G2F_data_2020/a._2020_phenotypic_data/g2f_2020_phenotypic_clean_data.csv")
labels2021 = read_csv("https://de.cyverse.org/anon-files/iplant/home/shared/commons_repo/curated/GenomesToFields_G2F_data_2021/a._2021_phenotypic_data/g2f_2021_phenotypic_clean_data.csv")
labels2022 = read_csv("https://de.cyverse.org/anon-files/iplant/home/shared/commons_repo/curated/GenomesToFields_G2F_data_2022/a._2022_phenotypic_data/g2f_2022_phenotypic_clean_data.csv")
labels2023 = read.csv("G2F_2023/G2F_2023_modified.csv", check.names = FALSE)
labels2024 = read.csv("G2F_2024/G2F_2024_modified.csv", check.names = FALSE)

#Filter to NYH2 & NYH3
labels2020 <- labels2020[labels2020$`Field-Location` %in% c('NYH2', 'NYH3'), ]
labels2021 <- labels2021[labels2021$`Field-Location` %in% c('NYH2', 'NYH3'), ]
labels2022 <- labels2022[labels2022$`Field-Location` %in% c('NYH2', 'NYH3'), ]
labels2023 <- labels2023[labels2023$`Field-Location` %in% c('NYH2', 'NYH3'), ]
labels2024 <- labels2024[labels2024$`Field-Location` %in% c('NYH2', 'NYH3'), ]

#Create single df; leave out 2024 as test set
labels2020$`Date Plot Planted [MM/DD/YY]` <- as.Date(labels2020$`Date Plot Planted [MM/DD/YY]`[1], '%m/%d/%Y')
labels2022$Source <- NA
labels2023 <- labels2023[,-c(1)]
labels2024 <- labels2024[,-c(1)]
labels_G2F <- rbind(labels2020, labels2021, labels2022, labels2023)

#Add uniqueID
labels_lidar <- labels_lidar %>% unite("uniqueID", c("field", "year", "plot"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE, na.rm = FALSE)
labels_msi <- labels_msi %>% unite("uniqueID", c("field", "year", "plot"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE, na.rm = FALSE)
labels_G2F <- labels_G2F %>% unite("uniqueID", c("Field-Location", "Year", "Plot"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE, na.rm = FALSE)
```


#CVBP - Random assignment of plots to train/val split for autoencoder
```{r}
set.seed(10)

nrow(labels_G2F)
#4000 plots

#Get plot numbers of training set
train <- sample(1:nrow(labels_G2F), 0.5*nrow(labels_G2F))

#Add 'uniqueID_num' column numbering G2F plots 1-4000 for unique field, year, plots
labels_G2F <- labels_G2F %>%
  mutate(uniqueID_num = as.numeric(factor(uniqueID)))

#Generate train/val split
labels_G2F <- labels_G2F %>%
  mutate(train_set = ifelse(uniqueID_num %in% train, "train", "val"))

#Add train/val split to MSI and lidar labels
labels_lidar <- labels_lidar %>%
  left_join(labels_G2F[,c("uniqueID", "train_set")], join_by(uniqueID))
labels_msi <- labels_msi %>%
  left_join(labels_G2F[,c("uniqueID", "train_set")], join_by(uniqueID))

#Add test to 2024 MSI and lidar labels
labels_lidar[labels_lidar$year == 2024, 'train_set'] = 'test'
labels_msi[labels_msi$year == 2024, 'train_set'] = 'test'

#Save files
write.csv(labels_lidar, file = 'lidar_labels_NYH2_NYH3_2020-24_CVBP.csv', quote = FALSE)
write.csv(labels_msi, file = 'msi_labels_NYH2_NYH3_2020-24_CVBP.csv', quote = FALSE)
```
